mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_task ( task_id, goal, status, last_event_sequence, active_step, result_summary, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{taskId}, #{goal}, #{status}, #{lastEventSequence}, #{activeStep}, #{resultSummary}, #{failureReason}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT task_id, goal, status, last_event_sequence, active_step, result_summary, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM agent_task WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_task SET goal = #{goal}, status = #{status}, last_event_sequence = #{lastEventSequence}, active_step = #{activeStep}, result_summary = #{resultSummary}, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
